comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term or notice period. You can cancel whenever you like; the fee is charged monthly in advance, and you keep access until the end of the month you paid for.
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till system and is not certified under the tax rules for cash registers. How to record online orders in your till system is something to check with your accountant.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a certified till system?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes online orders before customers reach the food truck: they choose the dishes and a pickup time, pay online or at pickup, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till system or a card reader (POS) takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.

kitchenCapacity.example: Example: if you can cook 4 mains in 5 minutes, set it to 4 items every 5 minutes. Total capacity limits orders across all selected categories, so if you want to sell at most 10 starters and mains every 5 minutes, set Total capacity to 10 items every 5 minutes and tick the Starters and Mains boxes. Your mains will still be limited to 4 items every 5 minutes.
